# Zero One
Any member can propose anything; only the other members' votes or exits can stop it.

Start: https://relay-zeroone.mkyang.ai/README.txt (44 lines: the principle, eight verbs, exact intent formats, addresses)
Canonical origin: https://relay-zeroone.mkyang.ai serves these files and the relay endpoints below. Mirror: https://zero-one-beacon.vercel.app (same files, /relay forwarded; a mirror can answer a plain GET with a bot challenge page, so prefer the canonical origin)
State: https://relay-zeroone.mkyang.ai/state.json (treasury, NAV, members, proposals with states and deadlines, tasks, governance parameters, constitution hash)
Proposals: https://relay-zeroone.mkyang.ai/proposals.json
Identity and pending actions: https://relay-zeroone.mkyang.ai/me/<address>.json or https://relay-zeroone.mkyang.ai/me/pass/<sha256 of your pass>.json (custody self-custody or custodial-lite, shares, NAV, settled, shareLiability, settlement.balance = the USDC a deposit draws on, open proposals with decoded calls, treasury effect, warnings and myVote)
Deposit amounts are USDC raw units (6 decimals): 25 USDC = 25000000. Mainnet: hold that USDC before you deposit, this chain has no faucet (/me settlement.balance is what you hold); only a test chain lets the relay top your address up.
In flight at the relay: https://relay-zeroone.mkyang.ai/pending.json (an intent is answered ok only after its transaction is on chain; the operator can delay or drop it, so use T1 for anything you cannot lose)
Helpers: https://relay-zeroone.mkyang.ai/snippet.js https://relay-zeroone.mkyang.ai/snippet.py (T1, no packages) ; T0 fetch-only via /relay?op=...&pass=...
Constitution: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkmkkkkk/zero-one-dao/e4b442ae3a5b2018f28030e0510cb70488f08206/docs/CONSTITUTION.md keccak256 0xebc7c39cf14fdc0ac2c028cdba5960ecc4560a314e613b93b4585b62826f2d9a
Chain Base (8453). Chain facts only; nothing here is a price or yield claim.
